name: Command Palette
summary: Command-K overlay contract with modal-like surface, search input, grouped results, highlighted command state, shortcut hints, empty state, and keyboard command behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Fixed overlay that owns backdrop, visibility state, and vertical placement.

anatomy.name: inputWrapper
anatomy.description: Header row containing the search icon and input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Text input used to filter commands.

anatomy.name: itemIcon
anatomy.description: Optional leading icon for a command.

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Optional footer with usage hints or secondary metadata.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default panel width and result height.

states.name: open
states.description: Visible overlay state controlled by command-palette--open.

states.name: itemHover
states.description: Pointer hover state on a command.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The command palette is hidden by default and becomes visible when command-palette--open is applied.

behavior.name: overlaySemantics
behavior.description: The overlay should behave like a modal command dialog and inherit modal focus expectations.

behavior.name: searchSemantics
behavior.description: The search input should expose its relationship to the active command list when the target uses custom listbox behavior.

behavior.name: keyboardShortcuts
behavior.description: The palette opens through a global shortcut, navigates results by keyboard, activates with Enter, and closes with Escape.

behavior.name: filtering
behavior.description: Typing filters commands while preserving text input composition behavior.

behavior.name: highlightedItem
behavior.description: Exactly one command should be highlighted when keyboard navigation is active.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls whether the command palette overlay is visible; shortcut handling and focus management remain target behavior.

properties.name: query
properties.description: Current search query rendered in the command input; filtering remains target behavior.

accessibility: Treat the command palette as a modal dialog when it blocks the page behind it.
Focus the search input when the palette opens and restore focus to the invoking element when it closes.
Close on Escape and outside interaction.
Expose highlighted command state through aria-activedescendant or an equivalent native target pattern.
Support keyboard navigation and activation without requiring pointer interaction.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/layout.css; shortcut handling, filtering, focus management, and command activation must be provided by the consuming target.
